items.title: Logic
items.text:
flowchart TD
    A[21 base stands] --> B[default];
    A --> C[fertilized];
    A --> D[partial blocking];
    A --> F{ditch depth>-0.40?} -->|yes| E[DNM];
    B --> G{thinning?};
    C --> G;
    D --> G;
    E --> G;
    G --> |yes| H[thinning scenarios]

This problem is embarrasingly parallel: each one of the 21 sites does not depend on the rest.

items.title: MultipleSusis pydantic-model
items.text:
Bases: BaseModel

Highest abstraction layer for the input parameters.

Enables the creation of multiple SUSI simulations.

Fields:

  • n_parallel_processes (PositiveInt)
  • simulation_parameter_list (list[SimulationParams])

Validators:

  • validate_configuration

items.title: n_parallel_processes pydantic-field
items.text: Number of parallel processes to spawn. Cannot be greater than the number of simulations. Must be higher than 1, 40 at most (40 is the maximum number of cores in a single node, at least in CSC).

items.title: simulation_parameter_list pydantic-field
items.text: A list of parameters fully specifying each run. The length of the list determines the number of simulations than will be run, regardless of how many parallel processes are specified in n_parallel_processes. E.g., a simulation_parameter_list of length 2 will execute 2 full susi runs no matter the number of parallel processes specified (which in such case can only be either 1 or 2).

items.title: validate_configuration() pydantic-validator
items.text: Validate the entire model after all fields are set.

items.title: L pydantic-field
items.text: Strip width, i.e., distance between ditches, m

items.title: age property
items.text: Age of stand for all nodes along the strip

items.title: cutting_yr pydantic-field
items.text: Year for cutting. Not used if year is outside the simulation period.

items.title: ditch_depth_20y_east pydantic-field
items.text: Ditch depth after 20 yrs, m, negative down

items.title: ditch_depth_20y_west pydantic-field
items.text: Ditch depth after 20 yrs, m, negative down

items.title: ditch_depth_east pydantic-field
items.text: ditch depth at the beginning of simulation (m). If given several values SUSI calculates scenarios for each ditch depth.

items.title: ditch_depth_west pydantic-field
items.text: ditch depth at the beginning of simulation (m). If given several values SUSI calculates scenarios for each ditch depth.

items.title: initial_dominant_stand_age_years pydantic-field
items.text: Age of the dominant stand at the beginning of the simulation. This is set to all nodes in the strip.

items.title: initial_subdominant_stand_age_years pydantic-field
items.text: Age of the subdominant layer at the beginning of the simulation. This is set to all nodes in the strip.

items.title: initial_understorey_age_years pydantic-field
items.text: Age of the understorey at the beginning of the simulation. This is set to all nodes in the strip.

items.title: n property
items.text: Number of computation nodes (which correspond to soil columns) in the strip, 2-m width of node

items.title: peat_type pydantic-field
items.text: 'S' if Sphagnum, 'A' if woody or carex peat

items.title: rho_mor pydantic-field
items.text: bulk density of mor layer, kg m-3

items.title: scenario_name pydantic-field
items.text: Scenario names, equal nmber of names than ditch depth scenarios.

items.title: sfc property
items.text: site fertility class for all nodes in the strip

items.title: site_fertility_class pydantic-field
items.text: Site fertility class. This is set to all nodes in the strip.

items.title: r = 0.05 pydantic-field
items.text: maximum fraction of liquid water in snow (-)

items.title: h_mor_from_drainage_and_mass_mor_Pitkanen(drain_age, rho_mor)
items.text: Depth of humus layer (in meters) from the hmuslayer mass (in kg m-2)

items.title: mass_mor_from_drainage_Pitkanen(drain_age)
items.text: Pitkänen et al. 2012 Forest Ecology and Management 284 (2012) 100–106 mass of humus layer in kg m-2

items.title: experiment_folder_path property
items.text: Directory Path for Susi simulation results: metadata, parameters, and netcdf file. It is given by parent_output_folder/experiment_id. This path must not exists.

items.title: experiment_id pydantic-field
items.text: A name that identifies the simulation experiment. This will be the name of the folder where Susi outputs are stored. The full path of parent_output_folder / experiment_id must not exist: otherwise we would be overwriting previous simulations' results.

items.title: metadata_output_filename = 'metadata.json' pydantic-field
items.text: Name of the output metadata file. Needs to be JSON. It will be stored inside the experiment_folder_path.

items.title: netcdf_output_filename = 'susi.nc' pydantic-field
items.text: Name of the output netcdf file. Needs to have extension '.nc'. It will be stored inside the experiment_folder_path.

items.title: parameter_output_filename = 'params.json' pydantic-field
items.text: Name of the output parameters file. Needs to be JSON. It will be stored inside the experiment_folder_path.

items.title: parent_output_folder = _app_settings.output_folder pydantic-field
items.text: The directory where the output of the Susi simulation will be stored.

items.title: timestamp_end pydantic-field
items.text: Final timestamp, recorded when the metadata dumping is done.

items.title: timestamp_start pydantic-field
items.text: Initial timestamp. (Technically, it takes the timestamp at the time the current class is created).
